verdict: Surging Sparks has held value better since release: SSP24 66.00 (Oct 6 mark, 100 = Nov 2024) vs DR25 57.81 (Oct 5 mark, 100 = May 2025); −34.0% in ~23 months vs −42.2% in ~17. Same calendar months May 2025→Jul 2026 (monthly reconstruction): −12.3% (79.76→69.93) vs −28.7% (100→71.30). Destined Rivals wins the chase (top three sold-comp medians $740.58 vs $500.00) and the ETB (lowest ask $115.00 · 21 live vs $129.99 · 9 live, Oct 7); booster bundles tie ($54.97 · 27 vs $54.99 · 33). Caveat on page: chase index (62) vs full-set capped index (250 of 252).
